title: Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte dead at 34
summary: Breaking Bad actor and disability rights advocate RJ Mitte died on Monday at age 34, authorities and his representatives said.

image.caption: U.S. actor RJ Mitte attends an event in Los Angeles in November 2025. (Frazer Harrison/Getty Images)

blocks.text: Breaking Bad actor and disability rights advocate RJ Mitte died on Monday at age 34, authorities and his representatives said.
Mitte, like the show's character, had cerebral palsy and was a disability advocate
Cameron County Justice of the Peace Cyndi Hinojosa told The Associated Press that she declared Mitte dead at about 1:30 p.m. at what she believed was his home in Brownsville, Texas.
She said she was unable to provide a cause, but an autopsy will be performed.

Mitte played Walter White Jr., the son of Bryan Cranston's chemistry teacher-turned-meth dealer Walter White on nearly every episode of the five seasons of the AMC show, which recently ranked as the best of the 21st century in a New York Times poll.

"Drawing from his own experience living with cerebral palsy, Mitte brought authenticity to the role and built a platform on disability awareness and inclusion," his representatives said in a statement announcing his death.
The statement said Mitte used "his platform to challenge stereotypes and promote greater representation for people with disabilities."
